answer: Pin every key to physical space via latency triangulation. Each epoch, peers exchange timing probes and estimate great-circle distance; keys resolving within one metro area collapse into a single voting unit - influence maps to ground like a falcon's territory, one patch per holder. A clone fleet parked in a few ivory towers speaks with one voice. Keeping weight means leasing machines across distant regions, paying transit, staffing foreign sites - per-clone costs outrunning flat rewards. Honest agents stand where they are; fakes must scatter thin as yarrow over truly separate ground.
